prompt: The Telegram bridge queue watchdog woke you for one of two reasons — read the wake payload to tell which: (A) the sweep itself FAILED, so dead claims may be stuck blocking their lanes. (B) The intake is STALE — no successful poll for over 120 seconds, so new messages are not being picked up. Do this: (1) verify the current state yourself — read ~/workspace/telegram-bridge/state.json (queue statuses, claim tokens, heartbeat_at values, last_successful_poll), the tail of ~/workspace/telegram-bridge/watchdog_recoveries.log, and the tail of ~/workspace/telegram-bridge/intake-errors.log. (2) For a failed sweep: if a claimed item's heartbeat is stale and its turn is gone, reconcile it by hand: release the orphaned claim (bridge_core.telegram --release UPDATE_ID CLAIM_TOKEN) so the intake's next poll re-claims it — never mark an unanswered item done, and never touch a 'sending' item without evidence of its send outcome. For a stale intake: check whether the intake hook is still enabled and its poll is ticking (hook logs) and whether the runtime is alive at all — if the intake is stuck but the runtime is alive, say what is stale and what you checked; do not restart anything you cannot verify. (3) Report the outcome briefly: what was stuck, what you freed or checked, and whether the queue is moving again. Do not send any Telegram message yourself unless Westin asks for one.
